# 101. Hide Set-Cookie header in nginx

**Date:** 2026-09-15

**Optional per env:** _required on all environments_


## CommCare Version Dependency
This change is not known to be dependent on any particular version of CommCare.


## Change Context
An issue was found in the nginx cache configuration
for certain requests under apps/download in CommCare HQ.

## Details
Nginx supports caching responses, and by default does not cache
responses that include the "Set-Cookie" header field. The app
cache (apps/download) was configued to ignore this header, which
enabled caching responses despite containing the "Set-Cookie"
field.

This change adds the "proxy_hide_header: Set-Cookie" directive
to nginx, which ensures this header is not included in cached
responses.

## Steps to update
To apply, simply run:

```
commcare-cloud <env> ansible-playbook deploy_proxy.yml --tags=nginx_sites

```
